sourceEvidence.meaning: User-to-browser OTP transfer is paired with browser-to-provider submission. Single-realm remapping changes realmB to realmA and B to A, not to app.
Single-realm provider Realm A owns authentication page and receives typed OTP; application receives neither typed OTP nor seed.
Device-factor variants reuse the independent Realm A browser factor journey. Requesting application, verification browser and Realm A are separate actors.

Current producer independently confirms Realm A owns the factor page, separate from the application.
